text:
people-ops: Heads up — new hire Maya Nguyẽn (starts Mon 4/6) has a name on her passport that includes diacritics which the background vendor flagged as a mismatch with the application. I-9 kickoff scheduled for Day 1 09:30. Can we coordinate a workaround for both BG and I-9?

maya_nguyen: yeah i saw the email this morning. passport shows Nguyẽn, app was entered as Nguyen (no mark). bg vendor says it failed automated match. i can provide passport, ssn card, and middle name docs. what works for the I-9?

alex_hr: thanks for flagging — main concern is BG identity verification and the I-9 name consistency. two options: 1) run manual review with vendor (extra 24-48h) if Maya uploads clear scans, or 2) do the I-9 in-person/notary on Day 1 and mark BG pending until manual verification completes. Which does Maya prefer?

maya_nguyen: prefer to get I-9 done day 1 in person if possible so laptop / badge isn't blocked. i can also upload high-res scans now.

bg-checks-bot: @alex_hr @maya_nguyen automated screen failed: name mismatch. Next step: upload government ID + SSN card to secure portal https://secure-bg.redwood.example/upload. Manual review ETA 1-2 business days once docs received.

jordan_it: for laptop & access: if I-9 is completed in person Day 1 we can badge and provision immediately. if BG manual review is still pending, we can give limited network access until cleared (devbox without prod creds). Maya — what's your address for overnight laptop ship if we need to accelerate?

maya_nguyen: 712 Waverly Ave, Apt 3B, Oakland, CA 94607. pls mark "leave at concierge" if delivery arrives between 9-5 — i'll be at work onboarding but might not answer the buzzer.

facilities: noted on delivery instructions. badge pickup at HQ desk is 10:00-16:00 M-F; we can do a reserved badge slot at 09:45 on Day 1 to speed things along.

onboarding-bot: Maya, your Day 1 orientation is scheduled for Mon 4/6 09:30 PT — meet in Zoom (link in calendar) for benefits overview, then campus badge/photo. Please complete new-hire paperwork and upload ID to the portal before 08:00.

alex_hr: Quick benefit note: if we need to delay formal benefits enrollment until BG clears, Maya you can still attend the benefits overview and enroll within 30 days. If you prefer, i'll email the COBRA/benefits FAQ and 1:1 link with our benefits rep.

maya_nguyen: please send the FAQ + 1:1 link. i'll upload passport + ssn card tonight. also can do notary at local UPS store on Monday morning if that helps.

bg-checks-bot: Received uploaded docs from maya_nguyen at 21:12. Manual review queued. Est. completion: Tue 4/7 by 17:00 PT. If manual review needs legal-name affidavit or certified translation, vendor will request next steps.

alex_hr: great — plan: do Day 1 in-person I-9 / notary option at 09:10, badge slot 09:45, orientation 09:30 Zoom (we'll stagger so you can join portions). Jordan will ship laptop overnight to Maya — tracking msg will be posted here. If manual BG requires extra affidavit we'll triage with legal.

jordan_it: Created express ship order #EXP-8821, picked up today 17:40. Carrier tracking: https://ship.example/EXP-8821 — expected delivery Mon 08:30. If I-9 completed in person we release credentials; otherwise we provide a limited dev VM and grant Slack + Zoom.

maya_nguyen: amazing, thank you!!

people-ops: tagging next steps: @jordan_it confirm device imaging profile (Maya - standard eng laptop + access), @facilities confirm reserved badge at 09:45, @alex_hr send benefits FAQ link. we'll loop back if BG vendor requests more docs. :+1:

jordan_it: Device profile: M-1-equivalent, standard ENG image, Docker + VSCode, no prod creds by default. Sending internal order #IT-314 in DM.

facilities: badge slot confirmed for 09:45. front desk will hold ID and we will coordinate notary if Maya brings printed docs.

alex_hr: benefits FAQ + 1:1 scheduler: https://cal.example/benefits-1on1 — FAQ doc uploaded to drive: https://drive.example/redwood/newhire-benefits.pdf

people-ops: closing loop here — overall schedule looks clear. we'll keep updates in this thread if tracking changes. anyone else?

maya_nguyen: that's everything for me. thanks everyone! :smile:

bg-checks-bot: Manual review completed 04/07 16:12 — identity confirmed (matched Nguyẽn -> Nguyen alias). BG cleared. Marking thread: resolved.

people-ops: perfect — welcome aboard, Maya! :tada:
